goals.source: Existing WinbackReports.dashboard monthly authorized team GMV inc VAT and existing GMV target as context only, copies or replica as configured. Capture time is not upstream freshness. Failed/malformed context remains nullable partial.
goals.actuals: Compatible net sales ex VAT, effective COGS/internal cost and expenses unavailable; actuals and achievement always null. No GMV substitution, actual profit, ROAS or accounting net-profit claim.
goals.hypothetical: Optional explicitly labeled complete net sales/internal cost/operating expenses, all ex VAT. No implicit unknown cost=0. Integer cents; gross profit=sales-cost; margin=gross profit/sales rounded half-up 4 places; cost ceiling=cost+expenses; profit after entered expenses=gross profit-expenses. Zero sales gives null margin; losses retained.
goals.storage: Existing commerce_promotion_drafts + commerce_promotion_draft_requests partitioned scenario.kind=financial_goal. No new table/migration or migration execution. Durable actor/request lock; body hash, immutable committed replay, revision CAS, source fingerprint recapture and atomic receipt. Promotion and Pack kinds/owners isolated.
goals.recovery: Browser owner journal verified before dispatch; duplicate clicks one intent; unresolved/lost reply reconciles original request before same-body retry; confirmed 404 only; 409 requires review. Persisted validated receipt establishes success. Stale backups require explicit latest/copy choice and fresh source/revision. Late preview after changed month is discarded; both stale-backup choices keep the current matching-period source identity.
